svg.title: Sand spit in three stages
svg.desc: Three stages in plan view: longshore drift carries sand along the coast, and where the coastline changes direction it is deposited in sheltered water and builds out as a spit across a bay; waves from another direction curve the end into a hook, and a salt marsh forms in the calm water behind it.

text.tspan: e.g. Inch Strand, Dingle Bay, Co. Kerry
